lines.zh: 我背着那对翅膀往前走
lines.en: I walk on with those wings on my back.

lines.zh: 袍子扫过地面,脚步很僵
lines.en: My robe sweeps the ground; my steps are stiff.
My hand lifts now and then.
I move slowly along the village road.

lines.zh: 那对翅膀在我背后轻轻扇
lines.en: The wings beat softly behind me.
I skirt a pile of hay.
My gaze is emptier than before.
I head toward where people are.

lines.zh: 喉咙里发出不属于我的声音
lines.en: A voice not my own comes from my throat.
I stop abruptly, then go on.
My fingers are counting something.
Step by step, as if led.

lines.zh: 这条路我走过,但不是我想走
lines.en: I have walked this road, but not by my will.
Scales of wing dust cling to my hem.
I look up at the sky a while.
The wings move first; then I do.

lines.zh: 我站着,翅膀在背后合着
lines.en: I stand, wings folded behind me.
My fingers twitch.

lines.zh: 我在听一个很小的声音
lines.en: I listen to a very small voice.
Something crawls inside my sleeve.
My head tilts slowly.

lines.zh: 我在记忆里找自己的名字
lines.en: I search my memory for my own name.
The wings beat very slowly.
I open my mouth, and no words come.

lines.zh: 那对翅膀替我做了决定
lines.en: The wings made the decision for me.
I stand as if awaiting orders.
My breathing is not right.
Wing dust settles on my shoulder.

lines.zh: 我用不属于自己的眼睛看你
lines.en: I look at you with eyes not my own.
The sound of you is pleasant.
I tilt my head; the wings tilt too.

lines.zh: 我认得你,又好像不认得
lines.en: I know you, and yet I do not.
My hand rises, then falls.
Do not fear; I hardly speak.

lines.zh: 我背后那对翅膀很漂亮吧
lines.en: The wings on my back are lovely, are they not?
There are things I cannot recall.
You're too close — my wings are trembling.
I hear you breathing.
The hem of my robe is torn.
The wings come before me.
This body still feels pain.
I cover the wound with my hand.
Strange; pain makes me lucid.
I hear my own voice.
I steady myself against the wall.
Wing dust scatters on the ground.
I can still stand.
You need not worry about me.
What are you offering me?
The wings behind me moved first.
I reach out, slowly.
This smell is unfamiliar.

lines.zh: 我好像很久没吃过东西
lines.en: I feel I have not eaten in a long time.

lines.zh: 你递来的东西我接不住。
lines.en: I can't take what you're offering.
I have taken it already.

lines.zh: 翅膀底下那个人，已经听我的了。
lines.en: The one under my wings obeys me now.
I hold it in my fist.

lines.zh: 我记不住这是第几次了
lines.en: I cannot remember how many times this has happened.

lines.zh: 我撞在柱子上，帽子歪了。
lines.en: I hit a post and my hat went crooked.
The wings beat twice to steady me.
My hand braces against the wall.
You struck me, but not me.
Your bump sent me back two steps.
You are standing on my robe.
I turn my body aside.
Too close together. Step apart.
Wing dust drifts.
Forgive me; I am slow.
I do not quite understand this.

lines.zh: 翅膀在我背后扇得很慢
lines.en: The wings beat slowly behind me.
I remember something.
Near you, the voice quiets.
I reach out, only to touch.

lines.zh: 你在我旁边,我不那么空
lines.en: Beside you, I feel less hollow.
I cannot remember much.
But I will remember this moment.
Do not go so far.
I will be right here.
I bend down slowly.
I will hold onto this.
It grows warm in my hand.
I count; there is only one.

lines.zh: 我这身法袍，早被蝶占了。
lines.en: A butterfly took this robe long ago.
The wings quiver.
I forget what I meant to do with it.
I will hold it for you.
This colour is nice.

lines.zh: 我记得有人给过我一个
lines.en: I recall someone gave me one once.
The wings suddenly stop.

lines.zh: 我的唤魔者还穿着灾厄的袍子。
lines.en: My evoker still wears the illager robe.

lines.zh: 有什么在我里面下了令
lines.en: Something inside me has given an order.
I do not want to do this.
But my hand is already raised.
I hear the sound of an incantation.
That is not my voice.
Stand back a little.
I will try to be slow.
I cannot fully control it.
I mean you no harm, truly.
The wings are seeing for me.
My fingertips have gone cold.
Do not stand there.

lines.zh: 我能感觉到咒语在成形
lines.en: I feel the spell forming.
I try to press it down.
It is more patient than I am.
I don't want to raise this staff.
I do not want to watch this.
I grip my staff until my knuckles pale.

lines.zh: 我的手挥出去,不是我想要的
lines.en: My hand swings out, not as I wished.
The incantation sounds on its own.
I cannot stop it now.
I am truly sorry for this.

lines.zh: 翅膀在我背后扇得很快
lines.en: The wings beat fast behind me.
I am pushed forward.
I shove you away with my eyes shut.
I bite my own tongue.
I remember who I am.
Do not come any further.

lines.zh: 我站在路中间,不知从哪来
lines.en: I stand in the road, unsure from where.

lines.zh: 一对翅膀在我背上展开
lines.en: A pair of wings opens on my back.
There is new dust on my robe.
I look at this place.
Wing dust falls first.
I hear someone calling me.
That is not my name.
I walk into the village, step by step.
The villagers step aside.

lines.zh: 我身后有一对翅膀在扇
lines.en: Wings beat behind me.

lines.zh: 火燃到袍子,也燃到翅膀
lines.en: Fire catches my robe and my wings.
I fall, wings first.
Water fills me up.
The blast blows the wing dust away.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西穿进我的肩
lines.en: Something sharp goes through my shoulder.

lines.zh: 那道咒语撞回了我自己
lines.en: That spell came back at me.

lines.zh: 我饿得连咒语都记不住
lines.en: Too hungry to remember the words.
The lightning curls my wings.
There is no road to walk here.
